entries.Original: Loads Overseas Casuals archive recommendations for the mapped season, then applies the favour mode from Settings.
entries.Translated: 加载海外休闲归档建议，然后应用设置中的偏好模式。

entries.Original:
Legacy importer for schedules copied from Discord.
The importer detects item names (without "Isleworks" et al) on each line.
You can copy an entire workshop schedule from discord, junk included.
entries.Translated:
从 Discord 复制的日程安排的传统进口商。
进口商会检测每行的商品名称 (不包括 “Isleworks” 等)。
你可以从不和谐中复制整个工作坊计划，包括垃圾。

entries.Original: Manual overrides for the currently loaded schedule. Archive loads already apply the favour mode from Settings.
entries.Translated: 手动覆盖当前加载的时间表。归档加载已经应用了设置中的优先模式。

entries.Translated: 警告：无法将所有重写都纳入基本计划

entries.Original: Automatically select next cycle on open
entries.Translated: 自动选择打开时的下一个循环

entries.Original: Automatically load archive recs on open
entries.Translated: 在打开时自动加载归档文件

entries.Original: Replace workshop 4 — credit favours already in WS1-3
entries.Translated: 替换研讨会 4——WS1-3 中已有的信用优惠

entries.Original: Min-max + free rest day — craft on OC's second rest day
entries.Translated: Min-max + 免费休息日——OC 第二个休息日的工艺

entries.Original: Loads the archived Overseas Casuals schedule as-is. Use manual favour overrides if needed.
entries.Translated: 按原样加载归档的海外休闲计划。如有需要，可使用手动偏好设置覆盖。

entries.Original: Workshops 1-3 keep the archive schedule. Workshop 4 is filled from the built-in favour solver, after crediting any favour crafts already produced by the recommended agenda.
entries.Translated: 工作坊 1-3 保持档案安排。工作坊 4 由内置的偏好求解器填充，其中包括推荐议程已经生成的任何偏好工艺。

entries.Original: Tries same-duration/category substitutions first, then places remaining favours on the lowest-value workshop slots so high-cowrie days stay intact when possible.
entries.Translated: 首先尝试相同持续时间/类别的替换，然后将剩余的优惠放在最低价值的工作时段，以便在可能的情况下保持高柯维日的完整性。

entries.Original: Same as min-max, but turns the archive's second rest day into a crafting day (C1 stays rest) so most favours can land on a "free" day.
entries.Translated: 与 min-max 相同，但它将档案馆的第二个休息日变成了一个制作日 (C1 保持休息)，这样大多数优惠都可以放在一个 “免费” 的日子里。
显示高级偏好覆盖控制

entries.Original: Shows manual favour-solver / clipboard override buttons on the Schedule tab.
entries.Translated: 在 “计划” 选项卡上显示手动收藏夹/剪贴板覆盖按钮。

entries.Original: Plugin log is available via /xllog or Dalamud log window.
entries.Translated: 插件日志可通过/xllog 或 Dalamud 日志窗口访问。

entries.Original: Import multiple presets with ease by simply copying them. Visland will read your clipboard and attempt to import whatever you copy. Your clipboard will be cleared upon enabling.
entries.Translated: 轻松导入多个预设，只需复制它们即可。Visland 会读取您的剪贴板并尝试导入您复制的任何内容。启用后，您的剪贴板将被清空。

entries.Original: Auto Enable Island Sanctuary Gather Mode
entries.Translated: 自动启用岛屿庇护所聚集模式

entries.Original: Enables "Gather Mode" when on your Island Sanctuary automatically when commencing a route.
entries.Translated: 在岛屿庇护所中开始航线时，自动启用 “聚集模式”。

entries.Original: Stops executing a route when you encounter a node you can't gather from due to full inventory.
entries.Translated: 当遇到由于完整库存而无法从中收集的节点时，停止执行路由。

entries.Original: Applies to non-island routes only. Will auto gather the item in the "Item Target" field and use the best actions available.
entries.Translated: 仅适用于非岛屿航线。将自动在 “物品目标” 字段中收集物品并使用最佳操作。

entries.Original: Will enable multi mode when you have any retainers or submarines returned across any enabled characters. Requires the current character to be set as the Preferred Character and the Teleport to FC config enabled in AutoRetainer.
entries.Translated: 当您通过任何已启用的字符返回任何保留字符或潜水字符时，将启用多模式。需要在 AutoRetainer 中将当前字符设置为首选字符并启用 FC 配置传输。

entries.Original: Food set here will apply to all routes unless overwritten in the route itself.
entries.Translated: 这里设置的食物将适用于所有航线，除非航线本身被覆盖。

entries.Original: Food set here will apply to this route only and overrides the global food setting.
entries.Translated: 这里设定的食物将仅适用于这条航线，并覆盖全球食物设定。

entries.Original: Node scanning will check the object table for nearby targetable gathering points, failing that will use your gatherer's reveal node ability and navigate to that. It will create a new phantom waypoint with the aforementioned information and navigate to it. Every phantom waypoint will also node scan. These special waypoints do not get saved to the route.
entries.Translated: 节点扫描将检查对象表中附近的可目标聚集点，如果失败，将使用收集器的显示节点能力并导航到该节点。它将根据上述信息创建一个新的虚拟路由点并导航到该路由点。每个虚拟路由点也将进行节点扫描。这些特殊的路由点不会保存到路线中。

entries.Original: This feature will have trouble with land nodes at the moment.
entries.Translated: 这个功能目前在陆地节点上存在问题。

entries.Original: Execute route once starting from this step
entries.Translated: 从此步骤开始执行一次路由

entries.Original: Execute route starting from this step and then loop
entries.Translated: 从这一步开始执行路由，然后循环

attributes.Translated: 尝试保留高价值的工艺品，尝试相同持续时间的替代品，牺牲最低价值的天数/工作坊

attributes.Original: MinMax but use the second rest day for most of the favours
attributes.Translated: MinMax，但大多数优惠请使用第二个休息日
最大化，保持相同的目的地

attributes.Original: Max out and select expedition bringing rare resources with two lowest counts
attributes.Translated: 最大限度地挑选探险队，带来稀有资源和两个最低计数

attributes.Original: Max out and select expedition bringing rare resource with lowest count in both granaries
attributes.Translated: 最大限度地挑选探险队，带来两个粮仓中稀有资源数量最少的珍稀资源
